observations.label: Generic mapping baseline

before.scope: Five-second aggregate Linux CPU sample and current load averages. Recheck immediately before and after every statistical run; does not prove future hypervisor isolation.

after.scope: Five-second aggregate Linux CPU sample and current load averages. Recheck immediately before and after every statistical run; does not prove future hypervisor isolation.

observations.boundary: One resident original 513x259 RGBA16 raster vertically flipped into an independent owned raster at the same dimensions/depth. Complete public FlipVertical, admission, allocation, materialization and disposal. Native public FFmpeg vflip graph produces a negative-stride view, then public frame allocation/copy materializes every output row inside each operation before releasing view/output. Graph/source/frame wrappers are reused. Native padded rows exposed directly. Exact row placement, alpha and hidden RGB; no output cache. Startup, IPC, I/O, generation, hashing and validation excluded; one CPU/filter thread, normal SIMD. Only this original whole raster is measured.
